editorial.blurb: Blufish Sushi Bistro elevates suburban sushi dining with fine-dining elegance, impeccable service, and creative, beautifully plated dishes that feel like a special occasion every time.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation to avoid waits—the spot is consistently busy, especially on weekends—and ask your server about gluten-free modifications; the kitchen is accommodating and they even provide gluten-free soy sauce.
